generator: Take distinct Fibonacci values 0,1,2,3,5,... as zero-based prime indices p[F]; subtract consecutive prime values in ascending index order.
observed_window_rule: Count each contiguous exact four-residue occurrence in the fifteen displayed differences; no rotations or reordered hits.
prediction_rule: The displayed last four residues, positions 12-15 one-based, seed a period-four prediction for the next eight differences: 8,20,10,6,8,20,10,6. No phase search.
extension: Append the next eight distinct Fibonacci prime indices after 987: 1597,2584,4181,6765,10946,17711,28657,46368. Calculate eight new differences and residues modulo 28.
comparison: Optionally display the same gaps modulo 29 as a predeclared alphabet contrast; no modulus search or scoring.
excluded: No alternative spiral, reverse order, skipped Fibonacci duplicates, gap definition, residue-to-rune map, or ciphertext decoder.
